text:
QUOTE: "It is not retried automatically, and "Try Again" resends the same post." and "the failed post's bottom sheet has a "Try Again" action (`app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx:46-49`) that calls this [`retryFailedPost`]"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says there is no automatic retry, that retry happens via the user's "Try Again" action, and that this calls `retryFailedPost`.
